title_block.title: OpenFlight ADC / Pi Interface Board — Rev C
title_block.comment_1: TLV320ADC3140 4-ch baseband ADC; RF board J1 (2x15) -> Pi 40-pin
title_block.comment_2: AVDD/IOVDD from Pi 3V3 (AVDD via ferrite). I2C addr 0x4C. BCLK-PLL clocking.
title_block.comment_3: AA filter sites 100kHz corner; CM caps DNP. Task 20.

findings.summary: No datasheets directory found (5/32 parts have MPNs). Sync datasheets before making pin-level claims.
findings.recommendation: Run datasheet sync via the digikey / mouser / lcsc / element14 skill (which one depends on the user's distributor access and API credentials). A ./datasheets/ directory with PDFs and a manifest.json enables pin-level verification in the next analyzer run.

report_context.impact: Review claims must stay at consistency level until datasheets land.

findings.description: ESD protection audit for generic connector J1: none coverage.
ESD protection audit for header connector J2: none coverage.

findings.summary: U1 pin ADDR1_MISO (ADDR1) missing pull-up resistor
findings.description: Pin ADDR1_MISO on U1 (TLV320ADC3140) is connected to net ADDR1 but has no pull-up resistor. This pin type typically requires an external pull-up to a power rail for correct operation.
findings.recommendation: Add a 4.7k-10k pull-up resistor from ADDR1 to the appropriate power rail.

fix_params.basis: Pin ADDR1_MISO is open-drain/input type requiring pull-up

report_context.impact: Pin may float or bus may not function without pull-up

findings.description: Net +3V3 carries power_in pins but has no power_out pin, no PWR_FLAG, no regulator output mapping, and no bridged solder jumper path to a sourced net.
findings.recommendation: Add a PWR_FLAG to declare the rail as externally powered (e.g. from a connector) or trace the rail back to a regulator output. If the source lives on another sheet, promote the net name to a global label.

report_context.impact: Rail has no source visible to the analyser; likely a wiring gap or missing PWR_FLAG.
